geofence[].description:
(optional) Provide an array of multiple coordinates that effectively "draw" a shape around the address. The most common and easiest approach for a property is to draw a rectangular bounding box.

Below is an example geofence for a bounding box approximately 100 meters (330 feet) in each direction of these coordinates: (36.197441, -94.165699).

Geofence:
1. Top-Left (36.198441,-94.166699)
2. Top-Right (36.198441,-94.164699)
3. Bottom-Right (36.196441,-94.164699)
4. Bottom-Left (36.196441,-94.166699)
